question:
The value of 

(3)/(7)+(2)/(7)+(1)/(14)-3=?
solution:
**Given:**

dfrac{3}{7}+dfrac{2}{7}+dfrac{1}{14}-3

**Formula used:**

Combine fractions and subtract the integer

**Calculation:**

dfrac{3}{7}+dfrac{2}{7}+dfrac{1}{14}-3

⇒ dfrac{3}{7}+dfrac{2}{7}+dfrac{1}{14}-3

⇒ dfrac{6}{14}+dfrac{4}{14}+dfrac{1}{14}-3

⇒ dfrac{6+4+1}{14}-3=dfrac{11}{14}-3

⇒ dfrac{11-42}{14}

⇒ dfrac{-31}{14}

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
